description: Avatar initials, language-neutral: initialsOf(name) in core/src/avatar/initials.ts. A character is a user-perceived character (a grapheme cluster), never a UTF-16 code unit. Words are split on white space. The core tests and the Flutter tests read this file, so both implementations answer the same cases.

initials.name: One word gives its first two characters
A one-letter word gives one initial
A letter with a combining mark is one character
A family emoji joined by zero-width joiners is one character
A script without case stays as it is
